faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Scientist D (medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Delhi Scientist D (medical) recruitment is 08-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Scientist D (medical) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MD/MS Ophthalmology degree to be eligible for the Scientist D (medical) position at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Scientist D (medical) post is 45 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Scientist D (medical) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Scientist D (medical) role at AIIMS Delhi will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Scientist D (medical) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Scientist D (medical) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 118110 Per Month.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Scientist D (medical) post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Scientist D (medical) position in this recruitment drive by AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application for the Scientist D (medical) post at AIIMS Delhi needs to be submitted via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the email is sent before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Scientist D (medical) position at AIIMS Delhi is a contractual job. Candidates should refer to the official notification for details on the contract duration.
